_comment: Path to Exile in HUMAN PLAY with only OUR creature on the board: the plan menu must carry exactly ONE target-less Path cast (the board click picks the creature at resolution, over both sides; exiling our own Kor Duelist then asks the tutor_etb basic-land prompt). Before 2026-10-17 a non-lifegain removal needed an opponent creature to be offered at all, so the self-target ramp line was unreachable for the human. (No creature on either side -> no Path cast at all: pinned by test/unit/test_path_to_exile.cpp, since CheckLine grades a target-less line on mana alone and would call it legal_not_enumerated.)
